title: Shilshole N (shore effects)
assumptions: Wind from 350 deg (N-NNW), waves toward 170 deg with a +-25 deg spread, single period 3.8 s (the Tp of an 18 km fetch at 22 kt).
Open water west of the pack is deep and unshadowed; the plane wave enters at the pack edge.
Marina breakwall reflection R = 0.6 (rubble mound / bulkhead mix, a guess); other shore R = 0.1 (beach).
Mean water level; no tide, no current, no wind regrowth in the lee, shore absorbs. Local fetch shelter still comes from the fetch map.
